'''Kelsek''' was the leader of the [[Justice Action Network]] (JAN) cell that operated on [[Mrlsst/Legends|Mrlsst]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a student of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Arkeld]] and was one of the original members of the cell.<ref name="LOTE" />

Kelsek was a colleague of the [[Ranat/Legends|Ranat]] [[Rik-tak]]. He was particularly skilled at recruiting new members to the JAN.<ref name="LOTE" />
